title: Have Lightsaber, Will Throttle
front_description: Battling winged enemies in the Geonosian droid factory, Anakin trips on the assembly line and his right arm becomes locked into a molding device. Facing an oncoming cutting machine, the young Jedi ignites his lightsaber and manages to maneuver his body out of harn's way. But when the cutter slams down it actually cuts his lightsaber in half. "Obi-Wan's gonna kill me," Anakin says with a quick shake of the head.
back_description: Dermot Power's early concept design of a Geonosian, Dooku's winged alien allies.
